courses.title: Product Design Strategy Foundations
courses.description: Product Design Strategy Foundations takes you from the basics of product design strategy to applying it on a realistic Product Designer scenario, through short lessons and hands-on practice. Along the way, you'll also get a practical introduction to visual design, enough to use it alongside product design strategy day to day. Expect a practical course, not a lecture-heavy one.
learning_outcomes: Applying product design strategy to a real Product Designer scenario
Practicing product design strategy through guided exercises
Getting a working introduction to visual design
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.title: User Research in Practice
courses.description: User Research in Practice is a focused course on user research for people already working toward a Product Designer role who want to go further. You'll work through applied exercises that push past the basics and into more realistic scenarios, with less hand-holding than an introductory course. By the end, you should feel noticeably more confident applying user research on your own.
learning_outcomes: Applying user research to a real Product Designer scenario
Practicing user research through guided exercises
Building a short user research exercise from scratch
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.description: Accessibility Auditing Fundamentals walks you through the basics of accessibility auditing, built for people new to Product Designer work. Expect short, practical lessons rather than a long project, with just enough depth to get you started.

alternates.title: Advanced Product Design Strategy Techniques
alternates.description: Advanced Product Design Strategy Techniques goes beyond the basics of product design strategy, for people already working toward a Product Designer role. It's built for people who already have some grounding in product design strategy and want to go further.
